unsettled.title: Unsettled expenses
unsettled.moveToDebtsConfirmBody: The share leaves the running balance and becomes a standalone debt, repaid whenever and however much you like from the Debts tab. Day-to-day expenses keep splitting and settling as usual.

compensate.title: Put towards a debt
compensate.pickDebt: Which debt should it go towards?
compensate.resultHint: No money will change hands: {amount} comes off «{debt}» and this share is marked settled.

debts.emptyBody: This is where big one-off expenses live — a house down payment, say — the ones you don't want weighing on the day-to-day balance.
debts.emptyHint: To create one: in the Balance tab, open the row actions («⋯») on the expense and pick «Move to long-term debts».
debts.moveBackConfirmTitle: Move back to the running balance?
debts.moveBackConfirmBody: The share returns to the unsettled expenses in the running balance.
debts.moveBackToast: Moved back to the running balance
debts.repayWarning: The payment comes off this debt. If it doesn't cover it in full, the remainder stays outstanding until you choose to pay it.

settlement.payAmountHint: You can pay only part of the total debt ({total}) and settle the rest later.
settlement.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero
settlement.amountExceedsBalance: The amount exceeds the outstanding balance
settlement.warning: Recording this payment will pay down the oldest outstanding debt first. If it doesn't cover the full amount, the expense will remain partially settled.
settlement.missingMembers: Unable to determine members for settlement
